name: Sun for the Dox night sky

source.title: PHI's view of the Sun in visible light

changes: Reduced from its orange colour table to one grey band (the JPEG's luma), cropped to a square of 1.02 solar radii, scaled to 256 x 256, the mosaic's tile vignetting divided out (the median, over 0.06 solar radii, of each pixel over its ring's median; the limb darkening kept), scaled so the brightest 0.1% of the disc is white, and the pixels outside the disc set to black. Not turned: solar north is up. The disc was fitted at (4806.2, 4803.4) with a radius of 3973.4 source pixels.
